summary: Check-Cap Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing that MBody AI Corp., the counterparty in its proposed business combination, has expanded U.S. operations to 11 states and entered Canada. The business combination was previously disclosed and is still advancing, with Nasdaq completing an initial review of the listing application on April 30, 2026. No specific deal terms (price, premium, close date) were provided in this filing. The filing serves as a progress update on the SPAC-like merger rather than a definitive agreement. Watch for final Nasdaq approval and shareholder vote timeline; risk-arb centers on regulatory and closing conditions.
